full_judgment: Shahabuddin Ahmed, J: The question raised in this appeal is whether pre-emption has been refused to the appellant on the ground of defect of parties upon correct interpretation of sub-section (2) of section 96 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act, 1950. This arises out of an order of a learned Single Judge of the High Court Division dated 31 March 1982 passed in Civil Revision Case No. 1248 of 1977, refusing to interfere with an order of the lower Appellate Court which set aside the trial Courts' order granting pre-emption and dismissed the application on the ground that, on the death of one of the petitioners of the pre-emption Case, his heirs were not substituted.
